Hypothesis Thesis: The Reverse World Hypothesis – An Anti-Matter-Dominated ParallelUniverse in FSUFT-U 8.7
Abstract
1. Introduction
1.1 Purpose
Formalize the Reverse World Hypothesis within FSUFT-U 8.7.Analyze preliminary data (AMS-02, Fermi-LAT, ALICE, OpenNeuro).Propose testable predictions for future data.Extend FSUFT-U 8.7’s scope to cosmic asymmetry and consciousness.
1.2 Objectives
Model anti-matter leakage and universe splitting mathematically.Simulate signatures (cosmic rays, gamma-ray lines, EEG correlations).Compare results to current data and outline future needs.Integrate with FSUFT-U 8.7’s Proto-Fluid Language Translator (PFLT; see "A Proto-Fluid Language Translator Grok.pdf", Page 8).
2. Hypothesis Statement
A parallel universe, dominated by anti-matter and stabilized by exotic matter ( ), exists in FSUFT-U 8.7’s 10D spacetime.Anti-matter leaks into our universe via 10D conduits, mediated by   ( ).Annihilation triggers universe splitting, conserving energy.Signatures include cosmic ray excesses, gamma-ray lines, and EEG correlations, testable with current and future data.

3.2 Reverse World Model
Anti-Matter Dominance: Stabilized by a conjugate scalar field   and exotic matter ( ).Leakage: Anti-matter flux via 10D conduits, proportional to  , estimated at 0–10% of cosmic ray flux.Annihilation: Triggers splitting,  , with  .Consciousness:   links universes, detectable via EEG correlations.
4. Empirical Constraints
4.1 Available Data
Cosmic Rays: AMS-02 and Fermi-LAT (https://opendata.cern.ch/, https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/) measure positron and anti-proton fluxes ( ;see "FSUFT-U 8.7 Mathematical Key.pdf", Page 6).Gamma-Ray Lines: Fermi-LAT’s 3.5 keV ( ) and 511 keV lines, JWST 2024 spectra (https://archive.stsci.edu/).EEG Correlations: OpenNeuro’s alpha wave (17 ± 2%) and BOLD coherence (0.9 ± 0.05; see "Compiled List of Outcomes 2 Grok.pdf", Page 2).Antimatter Nuclei: ALICE’s antihyperhelium-4 (https://opendata.cern.ch/) aligns with FSUFT-U 8.7’s asymmetry ( ).
4.2 Data Gaps
Cosmic Rays: Need Fermi-LAT 2026 for higher sensitivity.Gamma-Rays: JWST 2025 Cycle 4 for line confirmation.EEG: Neuralink 2026 for non-local correlation precision.Antimatter: ATLAS Run 4 for increased yields.
5. Testable Predictions
1. Cosmic Ray Excess:   exceeds Standard Model by 0–10%.2. Gamma-Ray Lines: 3.5 keV and 511 keV lines at  .3. EEG Correlations: Cross-subject correlations at  .4. Antimatter Yields: Increased antihyperhelium-4,  .
